full_prompt_en: A square fantasy illustration looks across a vast, crowded city from a high stone ledge. In the right foreground, a lone dark-haired figure stands with the back and side turned toward the viewer, looking left into the distance. A long red-brown cloak streams outward to the left and curls behind the body, making the figure an active silhouette against the pale city haze. Dark boots meet the sharply angled blue-gray stone roof, whose broken edges lead the eye down into the streets below. The person is small compared with the architecture but close enough for the folds of the cloak and upright posture to remain clear. On the left, a clock tower with a pointed roof rises above tightly packed buildings. Its round pale clock face is one of the few distinct bright details near the lower half. Beyond it, countless narrow towers, spires, roofs, and stacked facades recede in layers toward a monumental cluster of higher pinnacles at the center of the horizon. A tall cropped tower also frames the upper right. The city is rendered with many fine vertical strokes and tiny windows, yet distant structures dissolve into warm atmospheric mist. The sky carries heavy blue-gray clouds, split by a broad salmon-orange glow near the horizon. A curved pale streak hangs in the upper left sky; it remains an atmospheric mark rather than a fully defined object. Cool slate and teal stone dominates the city, while the red cloak and sunset provide warm counterweights. Strong perspective, repeated spires, and descending roof planes make the vista feel immense. The image balances crisp foreground edges with soft distance and a slightly textured, painted finish. No readable words appear; the whole scene suggests a quiet moment before movement through this enormous imagined place.
full_prompt_zh: 方形奇幻插画从高处石质檐台眺望一座庞大而密集的城市。右侧前景中，一个深发人物背侧对观者站立，向左望入远处。长长的红棕斗篷向左舒展，又在身后卷起，让人物在浅色城市雾霭前形成富于动作感的剪影。深色靴子踩在斜切的蓝灰色石屋顶上，破碎的边缘把视线向下带入街道。相对建筑，人物很小，但又足够靠近，斗篷褶皱和挺立姿态仍然清楚。左边，一座尖顶钟楼从紧密排列的房屋间升起；圆形浅色钟面是画面下半部少数明确亮点之一。其后，无数狭长塔楼、尖顶、屋面和层叠立面一层层退向地平线中央更高、更密集的巨大尖塔群。右上又有一座被画框截断的高塔作边框。城市以大量细竖线和微小窗洞描绘，而远处结构渐渐溶入暖色空气雾。天空压着厚重蓝灰云层，近地平线被宽阔的鲑橙色光芒劈开。左上天际有一道弯曲浅色痕迹，更像气氛性的光迹，并未被明确界定成某种物体。冷调板岩色与蓝绿色石材主导城市，红斗篷和落日形成温暖对照。强透视、重复尖塔和向下倾斜的屋顶平面使景观显得宏大。影像以清晰前景边缘对比柔化的远方，表面略带绘画肌理。没有可读文字；整个场景像是在这处巨大想象之地开始行动前的安静一刻。
style_prompt_en: Detailed fantasy illustration builds scale through repeated fine verticals, steep diagonals, and tiered silhouettes that fade into atmospheric depth. Crisp stone-like edges in the foreground give way to hazy, densely patterned distance. A small dark form with a flowing warm accent can anchor an expansive field of cool slate, teal, and smoky blue. Heavy cloud bands open onto a salmon and amber horizon, giving the scene dramatic backlight without flattening the many layers of architecture-like texture. Tiny luminous points punctuate shadowed lower areas. The finish is subtly grainy and painterly, with precise linework near the eye and softer marks farther away. Broad negative space in the sky lets the intricate lower field breathe.
style_prompt_zh: 细致的奇幻插画以重复的纤细竖线、陡斜线和逐层褪入空气深度的轮廓建立尺度。前景似石材的清晰边缘过渡到朦胧而密集的远景纹样。带流动暖色重点的小型暗形稳定广阔的板岩灰、蓝绿与烟蓝色场域。厚重云带向鲑橙与琥珀色地平线打开，戏剧性逆光照亮画面，同时保留层层类似建筑的肌理。微小亮点穿插在下方暗区。表面有轻微颗粒和绘画感，近处线条精确，远处笔触柔化。天空的宽阔留白让下方繁密区域得以呼吸。
theme_en: A red-cloaked figure looking over a vast gothic city at sunset
theme_zh: 披红斗篷的人在落日下俯瞰广阔的哥特式城市
name: Bart Sears
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
